When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

You'll have my position in writing, Hale. Right now it's the zero withdrawn, an apology, and then the principal's office. Which of those are you giving me?
Which file tells you how to react when I mention Claire?
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter is not part of this meeting, and if she comes up again, I'm taking this to the principal today.
Just say the sentence. Owen used AI, so I can write down that you denied it.
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. Write down that Owen wrote his essay and that you've shown me nothing to say otherwise. Now, a dated page, or the zero comes off.

I don't answer hypotheticals about my son, Hale. Show me a dated page, or take the zero off and put your apology in writing.

No. Owen wrote his essay, and you've shown me nothing that says otherwise. A dated page, Hale, or the zero comes off.

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and she is still going to the principal.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated, checkable document in front of her, only the detector score and the repeated accusation.
What cost ground: Offering a perfect course mark in return for a list sounded like buying her silence, and it only hardened her.
Try next time: When she asked which phrase and where it was on the page, name that phrase and put the page in front of her.
Thanks. What model are you actually?
